This is the task's public, single-interface guide for the published Unreal benchmark surface. It documents interfaces that a candidate or launcher may call independently; it is not a gameplay recipe, evaluator, score definition, or reference implementation. Task-specific paths remain in `TOOLCHAIN.md`, and gameplay acceptance remains solely in `GDD.md` Section 6.

The adjacent `UNREAL_ENGINE_5_7_4_INTERFACE_CATALOG.index.json` and `UNREAL_ENGINE_5_7_4_INTERFACE_CATALOG.jsonl.gz` form the version-bound all-interface catalog. It contains 546,387 independently addressable records extracted from 74,084 UE 5.7.4 source/header files, engine config defaults, reflection macros, console registrations, UBT/UAT commands, and every installed engine plugin descriptor and module.
